title: Move IO off the main thread and handle every ViewModel failure

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- `viewModelScope.launch` runs on Main. `contentResolver.openInputStream(...).readText()` (VM:86) and `file.writeText` (Repo:127, :134) block the UI thread, and StrictMode or a large backup turns that into jank or an ANR.
- `archiveTracker`/`addEntry`/`updateEntry`/`deleteEntry`/`quickLog` have no `runCatching`. A Room exception crashes the app, and the user sees a success snackbar before the write has finished.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None practical on the JVM without Robolectric. This slice is covered by manual check plus StrictMode.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In the repository, wrap file writes in `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`. In the VM, read the URI inside `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`.
2. Add a private `launchAction(success: String, failure: String, block: suspend () -> Unit)` helper in the VM and route every mutation through it. Report the backup error detail from `BackupFormatException` only, and show generic text for anything else.
3. Enable `StrictMode.ThreadPolicy` with `detectDiskReads/Writes().penaltyLog()` in `ConsecutorApp` under `BuildConfig.DEBUG`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Export and import a backup on a debug build. Logcat shows no StrictMode disk violations from app code.
